meta.note: IDs are allocated here once and never reused. Every scenario carries @case:N; an N missing here is an error, not a new case.

1.title: Reserved collateral never exceeds the pool
steps: eth_call poolAmounts(address) and reservedAmounts(address) on the Vault
Expect reservedAmount <= poolAmount, compared as BigInt

2.title: The oracle spread is never inverted
steps: eth_call getMinPrice(address) and getMaxPrice(address)

43.title: An account can be initialised exactly once
steps: call initializeAccount() → expect event AccountInitialized(account)
call accountExists(account) → expect true
call initializeAccount() again → expect revert AccountExists()

steps: approve(vault, 100) then call deposit(100) → expect revert AccountNotFound()

steps: read vault.reserves() → (held0, ledger0)
call deposit(1000e6) → expect event Deposited(account, 1000e6)
read vault.balanceOf(account) → expect +1000e6
read vault.reserves() → expect held and ledger both +1000e6

46.title: Withdrawal is capped at free collateral
steps: read freeCollateral(account) → f
call withdraw(f + 1) → expect revert InsufficientCollateral(f, f+1)
call withdraw(f) → expect success
read freeCollateral(account) → expect ≤ 0

47.title: An account below zero can withdraw nothing
steps: read vault.balanceOf(account) → expect < 0
call withdraw(1) → expect revert InsufficientCollateral

steps: call deposit(0) → expect revert ZeroAmount()
call withdraw(0) → expect revert ZeroAmount()

steps: call addMarket("LINK-PERP", params) → expect returned id == marketCount before
read getMarket(id).status → expect Active
read getMarket(id).lastFundingTime → expect a multiple of fundingIntervalSec

52.title: A non-admin cannot add a market
steps: call addMarket(...) → expect revert NotAdmin()

53.title: Parameters that cannot work together are refused
steps: params with maintenanceMarginBps == initialMarginBps → expect revert BadParams("maintenanceMarginBps")
params with initialMarginBps 200 and maxLeverage 100 → expect revert InvalidLeverage()
params with takerFeeBps 501 → expect revert BadParams("takerFeeBps")
params with makerFeeBps < -takerFeeBps → expect revert BadParams("makerFeeBps")

54.title: The market count is capped
steps: add markets until marketCount == MAX_MARKETS
call addMarket once more → expect revert TooManyMarkets()

55.title: A Paused market rejects every new order, including reducing ones
steps: call setMarketStatus(m, Paused, 0)
place a reducing market sell → expect revert MarketPaused(m)
call cancelOrder on a resting order → expect success

56.title: A ReduceOnly market accepts only orders that shrink a position
steps: call setMarketStatus(m, ReduceOnly, 0)
place buy 1 → expect revert ReduceOnlyViolation()
place sell 3 (would flip) → expect revert ReduceOnlyViolation()
place sell 1 → expect fill; read getPosition → size 1

steps: call setMarketStatus(m, Settling, 0) → expect revert BadParams("settlementPrice")
call setMarketStatus(m, Settling, 2600e8) → expect event MarketStatusChanged
place any order → expect revert MarketSettling(m)

steps: call settlePosition(alice, m) from a keeper → read getPosition(alice).size → expect 0; realizedPnl +100e6
call settlePosition(bob, m) → realizedPnl -100e6
call settlePosition(alice, m) again → expect revert NoPosition()

59.title: settlePosition on an Active market reverts
steps: call settlePosition(account, m) → expect revert MarketNotSettling(m)

steps: place Market buy 1 on an empty book → read getOrder(id).status → expect Filled
read getPosition.entryPrice → expect index × (1 + backstopSpread)

62.title: A market order larger than available liquidity fills what it can and cancels the rest
steps: place Market buy of backstopMaxSize + 50 on an empty book
read getOrder(id).filled → expect backstopMaxSize; status Cancelled
expect event OrderCancelled(reason "unfilled")

63.title: A GTC limit that does not cross rests on the book
steps: place Limit buy 1 at index × 0.96 → read getOrder(id).status → expect Open
call getOrderBook(m, 5) → expect a bid level at that price with source 0

steps: place Limit buy at P + 20 ticks → read getPosition.entryPrice → expect P

steps: place Limit buy 3 at P → read getOrder(id) → expect filled 1, status Open, size 3

66.title: IOC fills what crosses and cancels the remainder
steps: place Limit IOC buy 3 at P → read getOrder(id) → expect filled 1, status Cancelled
read getAccount.openOrders → expect 0

67.title: FOK reverts when the full size cannot be filled, taking nothing
steps: place Limit FOK buy 2 at P → expect revert FillOrKillUnfillable(1, 2)
read the resting ask → expect filled 0

68.title: FOK fills completely when liquidity suffices
steps: place Limit FOK buy 1 at P → read getOrder(id).status → expect Filled

69.title: FOK counts the backstop when the limit reaches its quote
steps: place Limit FOK buy 50 at index × (1 + spread) + 1 tick on an empty book → expect Filled at the backstop ask

70.title: PostOnly rests when it does not cross
steps: place PostOnly buy at index × 0.996 (inside the backstop spread) → expect status Open

71.title: PostOnly that would cross is rejected with the best opposite price
steps: place PostOnly buy at P → expect revert PostOnlyWouldCross(P, B) — B is the better of book and backstop

steps: place StopMarket buy trigger index + 100 → read getOrder(id).status → expect Pending
read pendingTriggerIds(m) → contains id
read getPosition.size → expect 0; getAccount.openOrders → 1

setMockPrice(m, T)
call triggerOrder(id) from any address → expect event OrderTriggered; status Filled; position size +1

read entryPrice → expect the backstop ask at T (below the limit), not the limit itself

75.title: Take-profit triggers in the opposite direction to a stop
steps: triggerOrder(id) at index → expect revert TriggerNotMet
setMockPrice(index + 100) → triggerOrder(id) → position size 0

triggerOrder(markOne) → expect success
triggerOrder(indexOne) → expect revert TriggerNotMet

78.title: Price priority, then time priority
steps: place Market buy 1.5 → expect A Filled, C filled 0.5, B filled 0

79.title: getOrderBook aggregates same-price orders into one level
steps: call getOrderBook(m, 5) → expect one ask level at P with size 2

82.title: An unfunded backstop does not quote

place Market buy 1 on an empty book → expect status Cancelled, filled 0

83.title: Self-trade is prevented

85.title: Only the owner can cancel

86.title: cancelAll is scoped by market, or all markets with the sentinel
steps: cancelAll(ETH) → expect return 2; openOrders 1

89.title: A fill larger than the position flips it, closing at the old entry and opening at the fill

90.title: Closing to flat clears the entry and removes the holder
steps: long 1; sell 1 → read getPosition → size 0, entryPrice 0
read holdersOf(m) → does not contain the account

91.title: Unrealised PnL in equity follows the mark, not the index
steps: long 1 at 2500 (mark 2500); setMockPrice(2600) → mark clamps to 2574
read equity delta → expect +74e6, not +100e6

92.title: Open interest is tracked on both sides and always equal
steps: after any fills read getMarket(m).openInterestLong and openInterestShort → expect equal
after a reduce → both decreased by the closed size

93.title: Estimated liquidation price sits below entry for a long and above for a short
steps: long 1 with thin collateral → read estimatedLiquidationPrice → expect 0 < value < entry
short 1 → expect value > entry

94.title: Mark equals index until the first fill
steps: on a fresh market read getMarkPrice(m) → expect == getIndexPrice(m)

95.title: Mark is the last fill clamped to index ± maxBasis
steps: fill at index × 1.008 → read getMarkPrice → expect index × 1.008
setMockPrice(index × 0.96) → read getMarkPrice → expect newIndex × 1.01 (the clamp)

96.title: Limit prices outside index ± band are refused on both sides, and the edge is accepted
steps: place Limit buy at lower − 1 tick → expect revert PriceOutOfBand(p, lower, upper)
place Limit sell at upper + 1 tick → expect revert
place Limit buy at exactly lower → expect success

97.title: Anyone can set the mock index until the market is locked
steps: setMockPrice(m, p) from a non-admin → read getIndexPrice → expect p

98.title: Locking the mock is admin-only and one-way; the admin feed still works

setPrice(m, p) from admin → expect getIndexPrice == p

setMockReading(m, p, now − maxAge) → getIndexPrice → expect p

100.title: updateFunding is permissionless and a no-op inside the interval
steps: call updateFunding(m) from a stranger inside the interval → expect return false; getFundingRate → rate 0, index 0

101.title: lastFundingTime always lands on an interval boundary
steps: warp to boundary + 1234 s → updateFunding → read getFundingRate.lastFundingTime → expect % interval == 0 and == now − now % interval

102.title: A positive premium makes longs pay and shorts receive
steps: warp one interval → updateFunding → read rate → expect > 0
touch both positions → long balance delta < 0, short balance delta > 0 (net of fees)

103.title: The rate is clamped to ± fundingRateCapBps

104.title: The rate is the average of premium samples
steps: samples +10, +20, +30 → rateBps → 20

105.title: Funding owed reduces equity before it is settled
steps: long with premium → warp → updateFunding → read equity → expect lower than before, with no fill on the account

106.title: An account above maintenance cannot be liquidated
steps: isLiquidatable(a) → false
liquidate(a, m) → expect revert NotLiquidatable(a)

107.title: The threshold is exact: no buffer on either side
steps: walk the index down $0.10 at a time; at each step: if !isLiquidatable → liquidate reverts NotLiquidatable; at the first true → equity < maintenance and liquidate succeeds

108.title: Liquidation closes partialLiquidationBps of the position and pays the liquidator
steps: liquidate(a, m) → read getPosition.size → expect half
read liquidator balance delta → expect liquidationFeeBps × closed notional
read getAccount(a) → liquidationCount 1, lastLiquidatedAt == now

109.title: A remainder below minNotional is closed in full
steps: position whose half would be < minNotional → liquidate → read size → expect 0

110.title: Bad debt is covered by the insurance fund
steps: crash the index far past the collateral → liquidate → read vault.balanceOf(a) → expect ≥ 0; insurance balance decreased by the deficit
expect event Liquidated with badDebt > 0 and insuranceUsed == badDebt

111.title: Once the balance is negative the rest of the position is closed in the same call
steps: crash deep → single liquidate → read getPosition.size → expect 0; liquidationCount 1

112.title: A paused exchange blocks liquidation
steps: setPaused(true) → liquidate → expect revert ExchangePaused()

113.title: The liquidation flag is visible through a getter
steps: read getAccount(a).liquidationCount before → 0; after a liquidation → 1; lastLiquidatedAt == that block

114.title: ADL fires only when the insurance fund cannot cover the deficit
steps: liquidate(bankrupt) → expect event AutoDeleveraged(short holder); short position 0; bankrupt balance ≥ 0

115.title: ADL does not fire while the fund can pay
steps: liquidate(bankrupt) → expect no AutoDeleveraged event; short holder position unchanged

116.title: ADL picks the most profitable, largest opposite position first
steps: liquidate(bankrupt) with a deficit the large short covers alone → expect only the large short closed

117.title: The taker pays takerFeeBps of notional
steps: taker fills 2501 notional at 5 bps → balance delta −1.2505e6 (plus pnl if any)

118.title: A negative maker fee is a rebate credited to the maker
steps: maker with −2 bps on 2501 notional → balance delta +0.5002e6

119.title: Net fee is split between treasury and insurance by feeToInsuranceBps
steps: taker 1.25, rebate 0.50 → net 0.75 at 50 % → treasury +0.375e6, insurance +0.375e6

120.title: setFees applies to the next fill
steps: setFees(m, 0, 10) → market buy 1 → balance delta −10 bps of notional

121.title: Every admin function rejects a non-admin
steps: from a stranger call setPaused, setMarketStatus, setFees, transferAdmin, addMarket, setMarketParams → each expect revert NotAdmin()

122.title: Admin handover is two-step and only the pending admin can accept
steps: transferAdmin(new) → read admin → unchanged; pendingAdmin → new
acceptAdmin from a stranger → expect revert PendingAdminMismatch()
acceptAdmin from new → admin == new; pendingAdmin == 0

123.title: acceptAdmin with nothing pending reverts
steps: acceptAdmin from any address with pendingAdmin == 0 → expect revert PendingAdminMismatch()

setMarketParams(m, invalid) → revert BadParams

128.title: OrderPlaced carries every order parameter
steps: placeOrder → decode OrderPlaced → expect orderId, owner, marketId (indexed), side, type, tif, size, price, triggerPrice, reduceOnly, userOrderId, maxTs all equal to the params

129.title: OrderFilled names the maker, and zero for the backstop

130.title: OrderCancelled carries the unfilled size and a reason

138.title: BTC: initial margin is 2 % of notional
steps: fund exactly IM − 1 unit; place 1 unit at index → expect revert InsufficientCollateral(free, required) with required == notional × IM

139.title: BTC: liquidation at 2x leverage happens far from entry

140.title: BTC: liquidation at 10x leverage
steps: open 1 unit with collateral = 10 % of notional; walk the index down; first liquidatable index → expect drop ≈ (10 % − MM) of entry

141.title: BTC: liquidation at max leverage (50x)
steps: open 1 unit with collateral = IM exactly; walk the index down → expect liquidatable within (IM − MM) of entry

142.title: BTC: positive premium → positive rate, longs pay
steps: fill above index on market 0; warp one interval; updateFunding → rate > 0; long balance decreases on next touch

143.title: BTC: negative premium → negative rate, shorts pay
